summary: Live Oak Bancshares filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated November 4, 2026 with Morgan Stanley, Keefe Bruyette & Woods, RBC Capital Markets and UBS as representatives, covering a public offering of 4,000,000 depositary shares, each a 1/40th interest in 8.750% Fixed Rate Series B Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock with $25 liquidation value per depositary share. A 30-day, 600,000-share overallotment option was granted. The offering, under an existing Form S-3 shelf, is expected to close on or about November 12, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing spreads and preferred dividend cost.
